analysis.summary: The migration to SST2 introduces critical failures in BFF authorization and broken references to essential validation schemas.

bugs.title: BFF Authorization Failure (Missing Credentials)
bugs.description: The client-side fetch calls no longer send authorization credentials to the BFF. The server-side BFF handlers (app-model and post-form) are explicitly configured to verify a 'staticVerifySecret' (now an x-api-key), but the client code that previously handled secret injection was removed without a replacement for the new SST Config parameters.
bugs.risk: Requests to the BFF will be rejected with 401 Unauthorized or 403 Forbidden errors at runtime, preventing the feature app from loading its data model or submitting forms.

bugs.title: Lambda Runtime Crash (Deleted Schema Reference)
bugs.description: The BFF handler in 'app-model/index.ts' references 'AppModelQueryParamsSchema' for request validation, but the corresponding schema (and its zod dependency) was deleted from 'src/bff/app-model/query-params.ts'.
bugs.risk: The Lambda function will crash at runtime (or fail during compilation/bundling) because it attempts to use a validation schema that is now undefined or missing, leading to 500 errors for all model fetch requests.
bugs.codeSnippet:
logger,
-    staticVerifySecret: process.env.STATIC_VERIFY_SECRET,
+    staticVerifySecret: JSON.stringify({
+      headerValue: Config.ENDPOINT_DIRECTORY_API_KEY,
+      headerName: `x-api-key`,
+    }),
     schema: {queryParams: AppModelQueryParamsSchema},

bugs.title: Broken Form Submission (Missing Auth Parameters)
bugs.description: Similar to the model fetch, the form submission utility had its verification logic removed. The code that previously appended 'rotatingVerifySecret' to the search parameters was deleted, but no logic was added to include the new required API key in headers or query params.
bugs.risk: Users will be unable to submit any forms (Newsletter, Contact, etc.). Submissions will fail silently or show an error because the BFF cannot verify the request's authenticity.

notBugs.reason: The removal of 'rotatingVerifySecret' is an intentional architectural shift from manual rotation to SST managed 'Config' parameters.
Replacing 'slash(join(...))' with 'posix.join' in the AEM fetch logic is a safe refactor as AEM specifically requires forward-slash POSIX paths regardless of the host OS.

notBugs.topic: Environment Variable to SST Config Migration
notBugs.reason: The change from 'process.env.AWS_API_KEY' to 'Config.AWS_API_KEY' is expected when moving to SST's Parameter/Secret management system and is correctly implemented in the stack bindings.
